## Classes

### <a name="manage_opensearch"></a>`manage_opensearch`

Include this class on every OpenSearch node that should report the
`opensearch` fact or manage `opensearch_*` resources. It writes the
connection settings to `/etc/puppetlabs/manage_opensearch/connections.yaml`
(owner root, mode 0600). The top-level parameters describe the connection
named `default`. `connections` adds more named connections, which resources
select with their `connection` parameter.

#### Examples

##### Connect to the local node with basic auth

```puppet
class { 'manage_opensearch':
  username => 'admin',
  password => Sensitive('secret'),
  ca_file  => '/etc/opensearch/root-ca.pem',
}
```

The following parameters are available in the `manage_opensearch` class:

* [`username`](#-manage_opensearch--username)
* [`password`](#-manage_opensearch--password)
* [`ca_file`](#-manage_opensearch--ca_file)
* [`client_cert`](#-manage_opensearch--client_cert)
* [`client_key`](#-manage_opensearch--client_key)
* [`verify_tls`](#-manage_opensearch--verify_tls)
* [`timeout`](#-manage_opensearch--timeout)

##### <a name="-manage_opensearch--url"></a>`url`

Data type: `Pattern[/\Ahttps?:\/\/\S+\z/]`

URL of the default connection. Defaults to the local node, so the facts
describe the node Puppet runs on.

Default value: `"https://${facts['networking']['fqdn']}:9200"`

##### <a name="-manage_opensearch--username"></a>`username`

Data type: `Optional[String[1]]`

User for basic authentication.

Default value: `undef`

##### <a name="-manage_opensearch--password"></a>`password`

Data type: `Optional[Variant[String[1], Sensitive[String[1]]]]`

Password for basic authentication.

Default value: `undef`

##### <a name="-manage_opensearch--ca_file"></a>`ca_file`

Data type: `Optional[Pattern[/\A\//]]`

CA certificate (PEM) used to verify the cluster's TLS certificate.

Default value: `undef`

##### <a name="-manage_opensearch--client_cert"></a>`client_cert`

Data type: `Optional[Pattern[/\A\//]]`

Client certificate (PEM) for certificate authentication, e.g. the admin
certificate.

Default value: `undef`

##### <a name="-manage_opensearch--client_key"></a>`client_key`

Data type: `Optional[Pattern[/\A\//]]`

Private key (PEM) belonging to `client_cert`.

Default value: `undef`

##### <a name="-manage_opensearch--verify_tls"></a>`verify_tls`

Data type: `Boolean`

Whether to verify the cluster's TLS certificate. Only disable this in labs.

Default value: `true`

##### <a name="-manage_opensearch--timeout"></a>`timeout`

Data type: `Integer[1]`

HTTP timeout in seconds.

Default value: `30`

##### <a name="-manage_opensearch--retries"></a>`retries`

Data type: `Integer[0]`

How often a request is retried when the cluster is unreachable or answers
with 503.

Default value: `3`

##### <a name="-manage_opensearch--connections"></a>`connections`

Data type: `Hash[Pattern[/\A[a-z0-9_]+\z/], Manage_opensearch::Connection]`

Additional named connections. The name `default` is reserved for the
connection described by the top-level parameters.

Default value: `{}`

## Resource types

### <a name="opensearch_action_group"></a>`opensearch_action_group`

Built-in (reserved, static or hidden) action groups are not listed and
cannot be changed. The title is either the name or `connection/name`.

#### Examples

#####

```puppet
opensearch_action_group { 'logs_read':
  allowed_actions => ['indices:data/read*', 'indices:admin/mappings/get'],
  type            => 'index',
  description     => 'Read access to log indices',
}
```

#### Properties

The following properties are available in the `opensearch_action_group` type.

##### `allowed_actions`

Data type: `Optional[Array[String[1]]]`

Actions and other action groups this group contains. The order does not matter.

##### `description`

Data type: `Optional[String]`

A description of the action group.

##### `ensure`

Data type: `Enum[present, absent]`

Whether the action group should exist.

Default value: `present`

##### `type`

Data type: `Optional[Enum[cluster, index, kibana]]`

Whether the group contains cluster, index or Dashboards actions.

#### Parameters

The following parameters are available in the `opensearch_action_group` type.

* [`connection`](#-opensearch_action_group--connection)
* [`name`](#-opensearch_action_group--name)

### <a name="opensearch_index_template"></a>`opensearch_index_template`

Index settings may be nested or dotted, with or without the `index.`
prefix, and with numbers or strings: `{ 'number_of_shards' => 1 }` and
`{ 'index' => { 'number_of_shards' => '1' } }` are the same. Attributes
that are not set are kept as they are in the cluster. The title is either
the name or `connection/name`.

#### Examples

#####

```puppet
opensearch_index_template { 'logs':
  index_patterns => ['logs-*'],
  priority       => 100,
  template       => {
    'settings' => { 'number_of_shards' => 1, 'refresh_interval' => '5s' },
    'mappings' => { 'properties' => { 'message' => { 'type' => 'text' } } },
    'aliases'  => { 'logs' => {} },
  },
}
```

#### Properties

The following properties are available in the `opensearch_index_template` type.

##### `composed_of`

Data type: `Optional[Array[String[1]]]`

Component templates, merged in this order.

##### `data_stream`

Data type: `Optional[Hash]`

Makes the template create data streams; `{}` uses the default timestamp field `@timestamp`.

##### `ensure`

Data type: `Enum[present, absent]`

Whether the index template should exist.

Default value: `present`

##### `index_patterns`

Data type: `Optional[Array[String[1], 1]]`

Index name patterns the template applies to. Required when creating the template.

##### `meta`

Data type: `Optional[Hash]`

Free-form metadata (`_meta` in the API).

##### `priority`

Data type: `Optional[Integer[0]]`

Templates with a higher priority win when several match an index.

##### `template`

Data type: `Optional[Struct[{Optional[settings] => Hash, Optional[mappings] => Hash, Optional[aliases] => Hash}]]`

Settings, mappings and aliases of new indices.

##### `version`

Data type: `Optional[Integer[0]]`

A version number for your own bookkeeping.

#### Parameters

The following parameters are available in the `opensearch_index_template` type.

* [`connection`](#-opensearch_index_template--connection)
* [`name`](#-opensearch_index_template--name)

##### <a name="-opensearch_index_template--connection"></a>`connection`

namevar

Data type: `Pattern[/\A[a-z0-9_]+\z/]`
_*this data type contains a regex that may not be accurately reflected in generated documentation_

The connection from the class manage_opensearch to use.

Default value: `default`

### <a name="opensearch_internal_user"></a>`opensearch_internal_user`

The password (or its bcrypt hash) is only used when the user is created.
After that it is ignored: changing it in the manifest does not change the
user, and a password changed in OpenSearch is not reset.

Built-in (reserved, static or hidden) users are not listed and cannot be
changed. The title is either the name or `connection/name`.

#### Examples

#####

```puppet
opensearch_internal_user { 'logstash':
  password                  => Sensitive('initial-secret'),
  backend_roles             => ['logstash'],
  opendistro_security_roles => ['logs_writer'],
  attributes                => { 'team' => 'ops' },
}
```

#### Properties

The following properties are available in the `opensearch_internal_user` type.

##### `attributes`

Data type: `Optional[Hash[String[1], Scalar]]`

Custom attributes, usable e.g. in document-level security queries. Values are stored as strings.

##### `backend_roles`

Data type: `Optional[Array[String[1]]]`

Backend roles of the user.

##### `description`

Data type: `Optional[String]`

A description of the user.

##### `ensure`

Data type: `Enum[present, absent]`

Whether the user should exist.

Default value: `present`

##### `opendistro_security_roles`

Data type: `Optional[Array[String[1]]]`

Roles assigned to the user directly, without a role mapping.

##### `password`

Data type: `Optional[Sensitive[String[1]]]`

The initial password. Only used when the user is created, never compared afterwards.

#### Parameters

The following parameters are available in the `opensearch_internal_user` type.

* [`connection`](#-opensearch_internal_user--connection)
* [`name`](#-opensearch_internal_user--name)
* [`password_hash`](#-opensearch_internal_user--password_hash)

##### <a name="-opensearch_internal_user--connection"></a>`connection`

namevar

Data type: `Pattern[/\A[a-z0-9_]+\z/]`
_*this data type contains a regex that may not be accurately reflected in generated documentation_

The connection from the class manage_opensearch to use.

Default value: `default`

##### <a name="-opensearch_internal_user--name"></a>`name`

namevar

Data type: `String[1]`

The name of the user.

Data type: `Optional[String[1]]`

The initial password as bcrypt hash, instead of `password`. Only used when the user is created.

### <a name="opensearch_ism_policy"></a>`opensearch_ism_policy`

OpenSearch adds defaults to stored policies (e.g. `retry` settings for
every action). `states`, `ism_template` and `error_notification` are
therefore in sync when everything the manifest specifies is present in
the cluster with the same value. Extra keys added by the server are
ignored. Lists must have the same length and order.

Updating a policy does not change indices that are already managed by an
older version of it. The title is either the policy id or
`connection/policy_id`.

#### Examples

#####

```puppet
opensearch_ism_policy { 'logs_retention':
  description   => 'Delete log indices after 30 days',
  default_state => 'hot',
  states        => [
    {
      'name'        => 'hot',
      'actions'     => [{ 'rollover' => { 'min_size' => '10gb' } }],
      'transitions' => [{ 'state_name' => 'delete', 'conditions' => { 'min_index_age' => '30d' } }],
    },
    { 'name' => 'delete', 'actions' => [{ 'delete' => {} }], 'transitions' => [] },
  ],
  ism_template  => [{ 'index_patterns' => ['logs-*'], 'priority' => 100 }],
}
```

#### Properties

The following properties are available in the `opensearch_ism_policy` type.

##### `default_state`

Data type: `Optional[String[1]]`

The state new indices start in. Required when creating the policy.

##### `description`

Data type: `Optional[String]`

A description of the policy.

##### `ensure`

Data type: `Enum[present, absent]`

Whether the ISM policy should exist.

Default value: `present`

##### `error_notification`

Data type: `Optional[Hash]`

Where to send a notification when a managed index fails.

##### `ism_template`

Data type: `Optional[Array[Hash]]`

Index patterns (with priority) whose new indices get this policy automatically.

##### `states`

Data type: `Optional[Array[Hash, 1]]`

The states with their actions and transitions, as in the ISM API.

#### Parameters

The following parameters are available in the `opensearch_ism_policy` type.

* [`connection`](#-opensearch_ism_policy--connection)
* [`name`](#-opensearch_ism_policy--name)

##### <a name="-opensearch_ism_policy--connection"></a>`connection`

namevar

Data type: `Pattern[/\A[a-z0-9_]+\z/]`
_*this data type contains a regex that may not be accurately reflected in generated documentation_

The connection from the class manage_opensearch to use.

Default value: `default`

##### <a name="-opensearch_ism_policy--name"></a>`name`

namevar

Data type: `String[1]`

The name of the ISM policy.

### <a name="opensearch_role"></a>`opensearch_role`

Built-in (reserved, static or hidden) roles are not listed and cannot be
changed. The order of permissions does not matter. The title is either the
name or `connection/name`.

#### Examples

#####

```puppet
opensearch_role { 'logs_reader':
  cluster_permissions => ['cluster_composite_ops_ro'],
  index_permissions   => [
    {
      index_patterns  => ['logs-*'],
      allowed_actions => ['read'],
      fls             => ['~secret_field'],
    },
  ],
  tenant_permissions  => [
    { tenant_patterns => ['logs'], allowed_actions => ['kibana_all_read'] },
  ],
}
```

#### Properties

The following properties are available in the `opensearch_role` type.

##### `cluster_permissions`

Data type: `Optional[Array[String[1]]]`

Cluster-wide actions and action groups.

##### `description`

Data type: `Optional[String]`

A description of the role.

##### `ensure`

Data type: `Enum[present, absent]`

Whether the role should exist.

Default value: `present`

##### `index_permissions`

Data type: `        Optional[Array[Struct[{
          index_patterns            => Array[String[1], 1],
          Optional[allowed_actions] => Array[String[1]],
          Optional[dls]             => String,
          Optional[fls]             => Array[String[1]],
          Optional[masked_fields]   => Array[String[1]],
        }]]]`

Index permissions: index patterns with their actions, document-level security (dls), field-level security (fls) and masked fields.

##### `tenant_permissions`

Data type: `        Optional[Array[Struct[{
          tenant_patterns           => Array[String[1], 1],
          Optional[allowed_actions] => Array[String[1]],
        }]]]`

OpenSearch Dashboards tenant permissions.

#### Parameters

The following parameters are available in the `opensearch_role` type.

* [`connection`](#-opensearch_role--connection)
* [`name`](#-opensearch_role--name)

_*this data type contains a regex that may not be accurately reflected in generated documentation_

The connection from the class manage_opensearch to use.

Default value: `default`

The name of the role.

### <a name="opensearch_role_mapping"></a>`opensearch_role_mapping`

The name is the name of the role. A mapping autorequires the
`opensearch_role` of the same name. The title is either the role name or
`connection/role`.

#### Examples

#####

```puppet
opensearch_role_mapping { 'logs_reader':
  backend_roles => ['ldap-logs-readers'],
  users         => ['alice'],
}
```

#### Properties

The following properties are available in the `opensearch_role_mapping` type.

##### `and_backend_roles`

Data type: `Optional[Array[String[1]]]`

Backend roles that a user must all have to get the role.

##### `backend_roles`

Data type: `Optional[Array[String[1]]]`

Backend roles (e.g. LDAP groups) that get the role.

##### `description`

Data type: `Optional[String]`

A description of the mapping.

##### `ensure`

Data type: `Enum[present, absent]`

Whether the role mapping should exist.

Default value: `present`

##### `hosts`

Data type: `Optional[Array[String[1]]]`

Hosts whose requests get the role.

##### `users`

Data type: `Optional[Array[String[1]]]`

Users that get the role.

#### Parameters

The following parameters are available in the `opensearch_role_mapping` type.

* [`connection`](#-opensearch_role_mapping--connection)
